note: Machine-readable cross-slicer capability manifest. Evidence levels: genuine-producer (a real producer binary made the fixture), real-destination-slice (a real destination slicer opened or sliced the result), spec-synthetic (fixture built from the producer's published or open-source format, labeled as such), mocked-parse (parser-level tests only), unverified (no executed evidence). A cell may only be upgraded when an executed test proves the higher level.
